_about: The Population Census page's counts over time, for its weekly arrows and its Over Time graph. days: one entry per refresh date (sync_census.py; all kept, census.py thins the page's copy); weeks: Raider.IO's weekly history, dated by the Sunday each week ends. Each: {date: {level (all, 60): {key: [Alliance's classes, Horde's classes, races]}}}, in census.json's class and race order. pairs: each refresh's race x class counts {date: {level: {key: [class][race]}}}, the last 14 days only, for the Every Race and Class list's weekly change.
